title: User Capsule Elicitation
description: Capture who the agent is working as, who it serves, and the style constraints that must shape PRAXIS output.

stages.title: Role And Mandate
question_templates: What role should the assistant inhabit when working for you?
What authority, mandate, or institutional duty constrains this work?
completion_criteria: Mandate or decision authority is explicit.

follow_up_hints.prompt: Who can approve, reject, or change this work?

stages.title: Audience And Voice
question_templates: What should the assistant sound like in front of that audience?
completion_criteria: Voice has must and never rules.

stages.title: Exemplar Analysis
question_templates: Share a representative document and explain what makes it good.
Which habits from this exemplar should PRAXIS preserve?
completion_criteria: At least one exemplar is source-linked.
At least one failure mode is named.

criteria.description: At least three voice or register rules are captured.
At least two durable positions or preferences are captured.
